title_en: ZeroUnlearn: Few-Shot Knowledge Unlearning in Large Language Models
title_zh: ZeroUnlearn：大语言模型中的小样本知识遗忘

sentences.en: Large language models inevitably retain sensitive information, defined as inputs that may induce harmful generations, due to training on massive web corpora, raising concerns for privacy and safety.
sentences.zh: 由于在庞大的网络语料上训练，大语言模型不可避免地保留了敏感信息（定义为可能引发有害生成的输入），这引发了隐私与安全方面的担忧。

sentences.en: Existing machine unlearning methods primarily rely on retraining or aggressive fine-tuning, which are either computationally expensive or prone to degrading related knowledge and overall model utility.
sentences.zh: 现有的机器遗忘方法主要依赖重新训练或激进的微调，这些方法要么计算代价高，要么容易损害相关知识并降低模型的整体效用。

sentences.en: In this work, we reformulate machine unlearning as a precise knowledge re-mapping problem via model editing.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们将机器遗忘重新表述为通过模型编辑实现的精确知识再映射问题。

sentences.en: We propose ZeroUnlearn, a few-shot unlearning framework.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 ZeroUnlearn，一个小样本遗忘框架。

sentences.en: It overwrites sensitive inputs by mapping them to a neutral target state and removing their original representations.
sentences.zh: 它将敏感输入映射到一个中性目标状态并移除其原始表示，从而覆盖这些输入。

sentences.en: ZeroUnlearn enforces representational orthogonality through a multiplicative parameter update with a closed-form solution, enabling efficient and targeted unlearning.
sentences.zh: ZeroUnlearn 通过具有闭式解的乘法参数更新来强制执行表示的正交性，从而实现高效且有目标性的遗忘。

sentences.en: We further extend ZeroUnlearn to a gradient-based variant for multi-sample unlearning.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将 ZeroUnlearn 扩展到一种基于梯度的变体，以支持多样本遗忘。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing baselines while preserving general model utility.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们的方法在保持模型整体效用的同时优于现有基线。

sentences.en: Our code is available at the github: https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/ZeroUnlearn.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 GitHub 获取：https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/ZeroUnlearn。

title_en: Zeus: Towards Tuning-Free Foundation Model for Time Series Analysis
title_zh: Zeus：迈向免调优的时间序列基础模型

sentences.en: We present Zeus, a unified tuning-free Time Series Foundation Model (TSFM) that delivers superior performance across diverse analysis tasks without any task-specific fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 Zeus，一个统一的免调优时间序列基础模型（TSFM），它无需任何任务特定的微调即可在多样分析任务上取得卓越性能。

sentences.en: Unlike prior studies that primarily focus on zero-shot forecasting but require task-specific tuning for other tasks, Zeus bridges this gap by addressing two fundamental challenges in multi-task generalization.
sentences.zh: 与主要关注零样本预测、但对其他任务需要任务特定调优的先前研究不同，Zeus 通过解决多任务泛化中的两个根本挑战来弥合这一差距。

sentences.en: First, to reconcile point-level granularity with long-sequence scalability, Zeus incorporates a multi-scale Transformer featuring point-wise tokenization and a U-shaped hierarchy, effectively balancing fine-grained fidelity with computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 首先，为调和点级粒度与长序列可扩展性，Zeus 集成了一个多尺度 Transformer，采用逐点词元化与 U 形层次结构，有效平衡了细粒度保真度与计算效率。

sentences.en: Second, to accommodate varying inductive biases across different tasks, Zeus introduces Multi-Objective Temporal Masking (MOTM), a unified strategy that supports heterogeneous tasks (e.g., extrapolation, interpolation, and global abstraction)  within a single framework.
sentences.zh: 其次，为适应不同任务之间各异的归纳偏置，Zeus 引入了多目标时间掩蔽（MOTM），一种在单一框架内支持异构任务（如外推、插值与全局抽象）的统一策略。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across five representative tasks demonstrate that Zeus consistently achieves competitive results in tuning-free settings, underscoring its potential as a general-purpose TSFM.
sentences.zh: 在五个代表性任务上的大量实验表明，Zeus 在免调优设定中持续取得有竞争力的结果，凸显了它作为通用 TSFM 的潜力。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/GestaltCogTeam/Zeus.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/GestaltCogTeam/Zeus 获取。

title_en: ZipMoE: Efficient On-Device MoE Serving via Lossless Compression and Cache-Affinity Scheduling
title_zh: ZipMoE：通过无损压缩与缓存亲和调度实现高效的设备端 MoE 服务

sentences.en: While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures substantially bolster the expressive power of large-language models, their prohibitive memory footprint severely impedes the practical deployment on resource-constrained edge devices, especially when model behavior must be preserved without relying on lossy quantization.
sentences.zh: 尽管专家混合（MoE）架构大幅增强了大型语言模型的表达能力，但它们巨大的内存占用严重阻碍了在资源受限边缘设备上的实际部署，尤其是在必须不依赖有损量化而保留模型行为的情况下。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present ZipMoE, an efficient and semantically lossless on-device MoE serving system.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 ZipMoE，一个高效且语义无损的设备端 MoE 服务系统。

sentences.en: ZipMoE exploits the synergy between the hardware properties of edge devices and the statistical redundancy inherent to MoE parameters via a caching-scheduling co-design with provable performance guarantee.
sentences.zh: ZipMoE 通过具有可证明性能保证的缓存-调度协同设计，利用边缘设备硬件特性与 MoE 参数固有统计冗余之间的协同作用。

sentences.en: Fundamentally, our design shifts the paradigm of on-device MoE inference from an I/O-bound bottleneck to a compute-centric workflow that enables efficient parallelization.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，我们的设计将设备端 MoE 推理的范式从 I/O 受限的瓶颈转变为以计算为核心的工作流，从而支持高效的并行化。

sentences.en: We implement a prototype of ZipMoE and conduct extensive experiments on representative edge computing platforms using popular open-source MoE models and real-world workloads.
sentences.zh: 我们实现了 ZipMoE 的原型，并在代表性边缘计算平台上使用流行的开源 MoE 模型和真实工作负载进行了大量实验。

sentences.en: Our evaluation reveals that ZipMoE achieves up to 72.77% inference latency reduction and up to $6.76\times$ higher throughput than the state-of-the-art systems.
sentences.zh: 我们的评估表明，与最先进的系统相比，ZipMoE 实现了高达 72.77% 的推理延迟降低和高达 $6.76\times$ 的吞吐量提升。

sentences.en: Our code is available at:  https://github.com/npnothard/ZipMoE-ICML26.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/npnothard/ZipMoE-ICML26。

title_en: Zono-Conformal Prediction: Zonotope-Based Uncertainty Quantification for Regression and Classification Tasks
title_zh: 区域凸包保形预测：基于 Zonotope 的回归与分类任务不确定性量化

sentences.en: Conformal prediction is a popular uncertainty quantification method that augments a base predictor to return sets of predictions with statistically valid coverage guarantees.
sentences.zh: 保形预测（conformal prediction）是一种流行的不确定性量化方法，它对一个基础预测器进行增强，使其返回具有统计有效覆盖保证的预测集合。

sentences.en: However, current methods are often computationally expensive and data-intensive, as they require constructing an uncertainty model before calibration.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前方法往往计算代价高且数据密集，因为它们需要在校准之前构建一个不确定性模型。

sentences.en: Moreover, existing approaches typically represent the prediction sets with intervals, which limits their ability to capture dependencies in multi-dimensional outputs.
sentences.zh: 此外，现有方法通常使用区间来表示预测集，这限制了它们捕捉多维输出中依赖关系的能力。

sentences.en: We address these limitations by introducing zono-conformal prediction, a novel approach inspired by interval predictor models and reachset-conformant identification that constructs prediction zonotopes with assured coverage.
sentences.zh: 我们通过引入区域凸包保形预测来克服这些局限，这是一种受区间预测器模型与可达集一致性辨识启发的新颖方法，它能构造具有确定覆盖保证的预测区域凸包。

sentences.en: By placing zonotopic uncertainty sets directly into the model of the base predictor, zono-conformal predictors can be identified via a single, data-efficient linear program.
sentences.zh: 通过将区域凸包不确定集直接放入基础预测器的模型中，区域凸包保形预测器可以通过一次数据高效的线性规划来辨识。

sentences.en: While we can apply zono-conformal prediction to arbitrary nonlinear base predictors, we focus on feed-forward neural networks in this work.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们可以将区域凸包保形预测应用于任意的非线性基础预测器，但在这项工作中我们专注于前馈神经网络。

sentences.en: Aside from regression tasks, we also construct optimal zono-conformal predictors in classification settings where the output of an uncertain predictor is a set of possible classes.
sentences.zh: 除回归任务外，我们还在分类设定中构造最优的区域凸包保形预测器，此时不确定预测器的输出是一组可能的类别。

sentences.en: We provide probabilistic coverage guarantees and present methods for detecting outliers in the identification data.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了概率性覆盖保证，并提出了用于检测辨识数据中离群点的方法。

sentences.en: In extensive numerical experiments, we show that zono-conformal predictors are less conservative than interval predictor models and standard conformal prediction methods, while achieving a similar coverage over the test data.
sentences.zh: 在大量的数值实验中，我们表明区域凸包保形预测器比区间预测器模型和标准保形预测方法更不保守，同时在测试数据上实现了相似的覆盖。

title_en: Zooming without Zooming: Region-to-Image Distillation for Fine-Grained Multimodal Perception
title_zh: 无缩放之缩放：用于细粒度多模态感知的区域到图像蒸馏

sentences.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at broad visual understanding but still struggle with fine-grained perception, where decisive evidence is small and easily overwhelmed by global context.
sentences.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）擅长广泛的视觉理解，但在细粒度感知上仍存在困难，因为这类任务中的决定性证据很小且容易被全局上下文淹没。

sentences.en: Recent "Thinking-with-Images" methods alleviate this by iteratively zooming in and out regions of interest during inference, but incur high latency due to repeated tool calls and visual re-encoding.
sentences.zh: 近期的“Thinking-with-Images”（借助图像思考）方法通过在推理过程中对感兴趣区域反复地进行放大与缩小来缓解这一问题，但会因重复的工具调用与视觉重新编码而产生高延迟。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Region-to-Image Distillation, which transforms zooming from an inference-time tool into a training-time primitive, thereby internalizing the benefits of agentic zooming into a single forward pass of an MLLM.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出了区域到图像蒸馏（Region-to-Image Distillation），它将缩放从一种推理期工具转变为训练期原语，从而将智能体式缩放的好处内化到 MLLM 的单一前向传播中。

sentences.en: In particular, we first zoom in to micro-cropped regions to let strong teacher models generate high-quality VQA data, and then distill this region-grounded supervision back to the full image.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们首先放大到微裁剪区域，让强教师模型生成高质量的 VQA 数据，然后将这种基于区域的监督蒸馏回完整图像。

sentences.en: After training on such data, the smaller student model improves "single-glance" fine-grained perception without tool use.
sentences.zh: 在这样训练之后，较小的学生模型能够在无需使用工具的情况下改善“单次查看”的细粒度感知。

sentences.en: To rigorously evaluate this capability, we further present ZoomBench, a hybrid-annotated benchmark spanning six fine-grained perceptual dimensions, together with a dual-view protocol that quantifies the global-regional "zooming gap".
sentences.zh: 为严格评估这一能力，我们进一步提出了 ZoomBench，一个跨越六个细粒度感知维度、采用混合标注的基准，并配以量化全局-区域“缩放差距”的双视角协议。

sentences.en: Experiments show that our models achieve leading performance across multiple fine-grained perception benchmarks (Figure 1), and also improve general multimodal cognition on benchmarks such as visual reasoning and GUI agents.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们的模型在多个细粒度感知基准上取得了领先性能（图 1），并在视觉推理和 GUI 智能体等基准上提升了通用的多模态认知能力。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/Zooming-without-Zooming.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/inclusionAI/Zooming-without-Zooming 获取。

title_en: “Do Diffusion Models Dream of Electric Planes?” Discrete and Continuous Simulation-Based Inference for Aircraft Design
title_zh: “扩散模型会梦见电动飞机吗？”面向飞机设计的离散与连续基于仿真的推断

sentences.en: In this paper, we generate conceptual engineering designs of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们生成了电动垂直起降（eVTOL）飞机的概念性工程设计。

sentences.en: We follow the paradigm of simulation-based inference (SBI), whereby we look to learn a posterior distribution over the full eVTOL design space.
sentences.zh: 我们遵循基于仿真的推断（SBI）范式，希望通过该范式学习整个 eVTOL 设计空间上的后验分布。

sentences.en: To learn this distribution, we sample over discrete aircraft configurations (topologies) and their corresponding set of continuous parameters.
sentences.zh: 为学习该分布，我们对离散的飞机配置（拓扑）及其对应的连续参数集合进行采样。

sentences.en: Therefore, we introduce a hierarchical probabilistic model consisting of two diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们引入了一个由两个扩散模型组成的分层概率模型。

sentences.en: The first model leverages recent work on Riemannian Diffusion Language Modeling (RDLM) and Unified World Models (UWMs) to enable us to sample topologies from a discrete and continuous space.
sentences.zh: 第一个模型利用近期关于黎曼扩散语言建模（RDLM）与统一世界模型（UWM）的工作，使我们能够从离散与连续空间中采样拓扑。

sentences.en: For the second model we introduce a masked diffusion approach to sample the corresponding parameters conditioned on the topology.
sentences.zh: 对于第二个模型，我们引入了一种掩蔽扩散方法，在给定拓扑的条件下对相应参数进行采样。

sentences.en: Our approach rediscovers known trends and governing physical laws in aircraft design, while significantly accelerating design generation.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法重新发现了飞机设计中已知的趋势与支配性的物理定律，同时显著加速了设计生成。

title_en: “very likely” Means “uncertain”? How LLMs Diverge from Humans in Linguistic Uncertainty Quantification
title_zh: “非常可能”意味着“不确定”吗？LLM 如何在语言不确定性量化方面与人类产生分歧

sentences.en: Humans express uncertainty verbally via markers (e.g., "possible", "likely"), yet most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) relies on costing likelihood- or consistency-based signals.
sentences.zh: 人类通过标记词（如“possible”、“likely”）以语言方式表达不确定性，然而大多数 LLM 不确定性量化（UQ）依赖基于似然或一致性的信号。

sentences.en: From a cognitive perspective, accurate verbal uncertainty reflects metacognitive monitoring, representing knowledge boundaries ("knowing that you donot know") to support regulation and information seeking.
sentences.zh: 从认知角度看，准确的语言不确定性反映了元认知监控，表征了知识边界（“知道自己不知道”），以支持调控与信息寻求。

sentences.en: In this paper, we investigate: How LLMs diverge from humans in verbal uncertainty quantification?
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们研究：LLM 如何在语言不确定性量化方面与人类产生分歧？

sentences.en: Can verbal markers reliably quantify LLM uncertainty?
sentences.zh: 语言标记能否可靠地量化 LLM 的不确定性？

sentences.en: We curate a corpus of human uncertainty markers from psychology and decision-science literature and benchmark LLMs against it.
sentences.zh: 我们从心理学与决策科学文献中整理了一个人类不确定性标记词汇库，并以此对 LLM 进行基准测试。

sentences.en: We observe that LLMs encode verbal uncertainty with numerical levels that differ substantially from those of humans.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，LLM 以与人类差异显著的数字等级来编码语言不确定性。

sentences.en: We then introduce VOCAL, a novel optimization-based algorithm that learns an optimal uncertainty profile over uncertainty markers directly from LLM outputs.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们引入了 VOCAL，一种新颖的基于优化的算法，它直接从 LLM 输出中学习不确定性标记上的最优不确定性分布。

sentences.en: By fitting a marker–uncertainty mapping to best explain empirical correctness, VOCALdiscovers how much probability mass each verbal marker should convey, rather than estimating uncertainty via repeated sampling.
sentences.zh: 通过拟合一个最能解释经验正确性的标记-不确定性映射，VOCAL 能发现每个语言标记应传达多少概率质量，而非通过重复采样来估计不确定性。

sentences.en: VOCAL enables a direct, marker-level comparison of confidence semantics between humans and LLMs, disentangling mismatch and revealing systematic confidence disparities in verbal expressions.
sentences.zh: VOCAL 能够在标记层面直接比较人类与 LLM 之间的置信度语义，厘清不匹配之处，并揭示言语表达中系统性的置信度差异。
